title: Plumeform plans and comparison table
description: Pricing on warm paper: a bold heading with an underlined side link, a white plan card with teal ticks beside a deep teal gradient card with a Monthly / Yearly pill toggle (the price swaps in with a quick fade-rise), then a rounded comparison table with tracked-capital headers, the highlighted row set in ink with a small italic mark, and fine print.
notes: use as="h1" plus compare.title and compare.links on a pricing page
the featured card forces dark colours over a chart-1 gradient
the table scrolls sideways inside its card on phones
needs JavaScript for the billing toggle; static HTML shows the first price
name: plumeform-pricing

props.name: as

props.description: an underlined link on the right of the heading
